items.title: BioMarin spends up to $490m for Alesta’s bone disease candidate
items.summary: The deal provides BioMarin with a potential rival to AstraZeneca’s blockbuster Strensiq in hypophosphatasia.

items.title: Trump expected to nominate Heidi Overton as new FDA commissioner
items.summary: Overton could take the helm at the FDA during a tumultuous period for the agency, defined by several resignations, firings and redundancies.

items.title: Andelyn Biosciences to develop GM2 gangliosidosis therapy
items.summary: Andelyn Biosciences is set to develop and manufacture a gene therapy known as AAV9-GM2, for Queen’s University to treat GM2 gangliosidoses, including Tay-Sachs and Sandhoff diseases.

items.title: BeOne Medicines and partners renew Brukinsa access programme for CLL
items.summary: BeOne Medicines, the BeOne Care Foundation, and The Max Foundation have extended their Brukinsa access programme for CLL until 2028.

items.title: Reformed pharmaceutical regulation across India’s drug landscape
items.summary: One of the major changes made to India’s primary legal framework for drug price regulation affects the pricing of essential drugs.
